nodes.title: SG-5.4.3 preload.test.ts with mocked dependencies
nodes.body:
Context: planPreload and resolveTextureKey exist in game/src/engine/planPreload.ts and BootScene (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) uses them, but game/tests/preload.test.ts does not exist. Desired behavior: one unit test file with all dependencies mocked proves deduplication, unknown-reference reporting, fallback key resolution and BootScene use of planner and fallback. Expected result: the file exists and passes under game/vitest.config.ts. Why: locks SG-5.4 behavior against regressions.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given game/tests/preload.test.ts, when vitest runs it, then all tests pass with every dependency mocked
- Given two objects referencing one known asset, when planPreload runs, then the asset appears once in load
- Given an unknown asset ref, when BootScene.preload runs, then it is not loaded and a warning is logged
- Given an unknown id, when BootScene.resolveKey runs, then it returns fallback:missing


## Scope
- In scope: game/tests/preload.test.ts
- In scope: game/vitest.config.ts alias only if required
- Out of scope: Changing planPreload or BootScene behavior
- Out of scope: Running Phaser, a browser or the real asset tree
- Preserve: Existing planPreload.test.ts, resolveTextureKey.test.ts and frontend BootScene tests


## Technical constraints
- Mandatory: Phaser, content, store and effect context mocked with vi.mock
- Do not change vitest config unless strictly needed


## Definition of done
- preload.test.ts exists and passes
- All three requirements verified


## Non-functional requirements
- Tests run in seconds


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · preload.test.ts proves planPreload dedup, unknown refs and resolveTextureKey fallback
nodes.body:
Context: planPreload and resolveTextureKey in game/src/engine/planPreload.ts are pure. Why: criteria of SG-5.4.3.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given two objects using asset A in the manifest, when planPreload runs, then load equals [A] and unknown is empty
- Given object asset Z and dust asset Y not in the manifest, when planPreload runs, then unknown equals [Z, Y] and load is empty
- Given unknown or undefined id, when resolveTextureKey runs with fallback fallback:missing, then it returns the fallback


## Scope
- In scope: planPreload.ts export surface
- In scope: preload.test.ts planner and resolver tests
- Out of scope: BootScene
- Preserve: planPreload and resolveTextureKey signatures and behavior


## Technical constraints
- Pure functions, no I/O, in-memory manifest

nodes.title: REQ · game vitest config resolves @game so BootScene can be imported from game/tests
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.ts imports from '@game/...' and game/vitest.config.ts has no alias, so game/tests cannot import it. Desired behavior: add the @game alias pointing at game/src, the minimal strictly needed change. Expected result: preload.test.ts imports BootScene without resolution errors. Why: BootScene tests must live in game/tests.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given game/vitest.config.ts, when its resolve.alias is read, then '@game' maps to the game/src directory
- Given the config, when tests/**/*.test.ts is matched, then preload.test.ts is included


## Scope
- In scope: game/vitest.config.ts resolve.alias for @game
- Out of scope: Other config changes, environment changes
- Preserve: include glob tests/**/*.test.ts


## Technical constraints
- Only the alias is added; no new dependencies


## Definition of done
- Alias present and include unchanged


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · preload.test.ts proves BootScene uses the planner and the fallback texture
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.preload calls planPreload, loads only planned image assets, warns on unknown ones and generates fallback:missing; resolveKey uses resolveTextureKey. Desired behavior: the fallback key is an exported constant and preload.test.ts asserts planner use and fallback resolution. Expected result: passing BootScene tests with phaser, content, gameStore, events and effectContext mocked. Why: criteria of SG-5.4.3.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given scene refs objects/bed (known) and objects/ghost (unknown), when preload runs, then load.image is called once with objects/bed and its manifest path and a warning names objects/ghost
- Given an unknown id, when resolveKey runs, then it returns the exported FALLBACK_KEY
- Given a loaderror for a known id, when resolveKey runs, then it returns FALLBACK_KEY


## Scope
- In scope: Export FALLBACK_KEY from BootScene.ts
- In scope: BootScene tests in preload.test.ts
- Out of scope: Behavior changes to preload or resolveKey
- Preserve: Existing frontend BootScene tests

- vi.mock phaser, ../src/runtime/content equivalents, store, events and effectContext; no real Phaser

steps.action: Import fileURLToPath and URL from node:url and add resolve.alias with key @game pointing to the src directory, keeping the test.include entry
steps.code:
import { fileURLToPath, URL } from 'node:url';
export default defineConfig({ resolve: { alias: { '@game': fileURLToPath(new URL('./src', import.meta.url)) } }, test: { include: ['tests/**/*.test.ts'] } });
steps.expected: Config exposes @game alias and unchanged include
